contact_sources.quote: Yimeng (Jessica) Liu CRO Chief Risk Officer Yimeng joined AQUIS Capital in Nov 2022 as Risk, Compliance, and Operations. She has over 15 years of experience in asset management and corporate banking across Asia and Europe. Yimeng started her career working at GE Capital in Singapore as Credit Analyst for Southeast Asia portfolio. In 2008 she joined Farema Capital, a London based Long -Short Equity hedge fund as the COO and junior partner where she was instrumental in launching the fund and established the fund operation and risk control procedure. She also worked with various start-up hedge funds and asset managers as external Operational consultant for new launch and regulatory licenses applications. Prior joining AQUIS Capital, Yimeng spent five years in the corporate banking sector in Zurich. Yimeng holds a BSc in Banking & Finance from University of London and a Diploma in Accounting

Prior joining AQUIS Capital, Yimeng spent five years in the corporate banking sector in Zurich. Yimeng holds a BSc in Banking & Finance from University of London and a Diploma in Accounting
